plan: With a private value of $13, I want to bid strategically to maximize potential profit. As a risk-averse bidder, I'll aim to bid slightly below my true value to minimize potential losses. Given the uncertainty of other bidders' values, I'll bid conservatively. A bid around $10-$11 gives me some buffer against potential losses while still maintaining a chance of winning. This approach protects my downside risk while keeping potential upside.
